items.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025
items.q: So I’m guesting with a big band on Tuesday and we’re doing three Gordon Goodwin charts, okay?

ctx.x: I know what you mean. It’s surprising after like oh my God it’s been like twelve months since I actually sat in an ensemble and read a chart.

Exactly. Yeah. So I’m guesting with a big band on Tuesday and we’re doing three Gordon Goodwin charts, okay? And I haven’t sat down to read a piece of music in quite a while so they handed me the charts and I looked at it and I thought yeah, I better start brushing up on this. So those have been my days and nights here.
I love that phrase, because I’ve heard it from other interviewees, in that “I didn’t really know what I was doing.” In effect you did because your ear was telling you that it’s okay.
